column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_deckswap.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point of rel_deckswap (ELF e_entry 0, the first 8 bytes of the module), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).

column2: void deck_swap_start(uint *deck, int card_list_count, ushort *card_list_states, int own_heap)
column3: Sub-module start of the deck swap screen. Clears the work blocks 0x00018cd0 (0x304 bytes) and 0x00018fe0 (0x6c4 bytes). With own_heap == 1 creates an FPL of 0x44e000 bytes, makes a heap 0x00018fb8 in it, allocates 0x9f000 bytes and opens a cardh.cip reader there (card_db_open_cardh_cip, 0x00018fbc); otherwise allocates 0x3af000 bytes from the duel-draw heap (system_duel_draw_get_heap) for the heap and reuses the large card-art reader (ui_get_large_card_art_reader). Stores the 0xc0-byte deck struct pointer (0x00018fa8), the save card-list count (0x00018fac) and the per-item card-list state array (0x00018fb0), lowers the thread attribute, starts the resource load (0x000099b8), sets font options by language (save_get_language 0 = Japanese) and sets the state word 0x00018cd4 to 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: those globals, heap/FPL allocation, font flags. Callers: exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_labo (1: FUN_00000034).

Sub-module update. State 0 (0x00018cd4) waits for the card reader (card_db_cip_is_ready) and the resource load (0x00009a38), then hides the loading overlay, fades in over 16 frames, goes to state 1, arms the 0x1518-frame (90 s) timer 0x00018fb4 when a network session is active, and starts music track 9 when duel set-up byte +0x194 is 4 or 5, else track 8. State 9 waits for the fade, then goes to 10; state 10 shows the loading overlay and returns the result of deck_swap_release_resources. Other states run the per-frame tick (0x000095f0) and deck_swap_handle_input. Returns true when the screen has finished and released its resources. Side effects: state word, fades, music, timer. Callers: exported; module callers via import stubs: rel_labo (1: FUN_00000034).

Teardown state machine on 0x00018cda. Step 0 frees the resources (0x00009adc) and the list buffers (deck_swap_free_lists); with an own FPL (0x00018fc8 > 0) it asks the cardh reader to stop and moves to step 1, else frees the heap (system_free_aligned) and its duel-draw block and returns 1. Step 1 waits for card_db_cip_is_idle and moves to 2; step 2 frees the reader buffer, the FPL block and deletes the FPL, then returns 1. Returns 1 when done, 0 while waiting (1 for any other step value). Side effects: 0x00018cda, heap and FPL frees. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update).

Allocates from heap 0x00018fb8 an entry array of capacity x 6 bytes at list +4 and a view array of capacity x 2 bytes at list +0x10 (capacity taken as u16). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocations, list +4 and +0x10. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_init_lists).

Builds the three editor lists at 0x00018cdc (0x20 bytes each: 0 main, 1 extra, 2 side): for each kind with a builder in the table 0x0001837c allocates the arrays with the capacity u16 at 0x00018388 + 2 x kind, stores the kind at list +0, calls the builder with the deck struct 0x00018fa8 and stores the count at +8, updates the total (deck_update_list_total), copies the count to the view count +0x14 and sorts the view (deck_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0)); then counts frames (deck_swap_count_cards_by_frame). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists 0x00018cdc-0x00018d3b, heap. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_init_editor).

Main-list builder: for each of the deck's main cards (count u16 at deck +0, ids at +0xc) writes a 6-byte entry (id, image index from shop_find_in_sorted_table(id, resource 0x8031), 1 copy, flags cleared) and the identity view index. Then, for each save card-list item whose state (array 0x00018fb0) is 1, sets flag 0x80 (card-list item) on the last unflagged entry with the same id (save_get_card_list_entry), and finally sets the key-card flag (byte 5 bit 5) on entries for which deck_slot_key_list_contains(1, id) returns 1. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list entry and view arrays. Callers: reached through the builder table 0x0001837c (entry 0) from deck_swap_init_lists and deck_swap_reset_lists.

Extra-list builder: entries for the deck's extra cards (count u16 at deck +8, ids at +0xa2) as in deck_swap_build_main_list (image index through resource 0x8031), then flag 0x80 on entries matching save card-list items with state 3. No key-card pass. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list entry and view arrays. No direct caller (entry 1 of the builder table 0x0001837c).

Side-list builder: entries for the deck's side cards (count u16 at deck +4, ids at +0x84) as in deck_swap_build_main_list, flag 0x80 for save card-list items with state 2, then the key-card flag (byte 5 bit 5) via deck_slot_key_list_contains(1, id). Returns the entry count. Side effects: list entry and view arrays. No direct caller (entry 2 of the builder table 0x0001837c).

For the three lists at 0x00018cdc frees the view array (+0x10) and the entry array (+4) on heap 0x00018fb8 and clears the pointers. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, list pointers. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_release_resources).

Sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of every entry with id card_id: copies of card-list items (byte 4 bit 7) go to the high 16 bits of the result, other copies to the low 16 bits. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_swap_get_card_sort_key, deck_swap_get_card_group_key).

Removes one copy of entry index: returns 0 when index is outside the list; with 2 or more copies decrements them; otherwise removes index from the view array (+0x10, count +0x14), decrements higher view indices, decrements the count +8 and shifts the 6-byte entries down. Updates the total and returns 1. Side effects: list arrays, counts, total. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_remove_card_move_source).

Copies a 6-byte entry to the end of the list's entry array, increments the count +8, appends the new index to the view array (+0x10, count +0x14) and updates the total. Returns nothing. Side effects: list arrays and counts. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_drop_card_move).

Clears the 7 u16 counters at 0x00018f3c and counts the entries (not copies) of list 0 (main) and list 1 (extra) per frame category (shop_get_frame_style_index(card_db_get_frame(id)), negative categories skipped). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018f3c-0x00018f49. Callers: 4 (deck_swap_reset_lists, deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_move_all_to_side, deck_swap_init_lists).

Rebuilds the three lists from the deck struct: for each kind with a builder in 0x0001837c re-runs it into the existing arrays, updates total, view count and sort, and clears the list fields +0x18/+0x1a and the nibbles of +0x1c/+0x1d (sort and filter state); then recounts frames and clears the pane 0 and pane 1 scroll/column/row words 0x00019026-0x0001902a and 0x00019052-0x00019056. Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Appends every entry of list 0 (main) and then of list 1 (extra) to list 2 (side) with one copy each (byte 4 low bits set to 1, flag 0x80 kept) and their view index, empties lists 0 and 1 (count, total, view count, scroll and sort fields), recounts frames and totals, resets the pane 0 cursor (0x00019026-0x0001902a) and re-places the pane 1 cursor with ui_place_pane_cursor (list layout when bit 0 of 0x00019050 is set). Returns nothing. Side effects: lists 0x00018cdc-0x00018d3b, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Recomputes the total copies of an editor list: list +0xc = sum of (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) over the entries (array +4, count +8). Returns nothing. Side effects: list +0xc. Callers: 5 (deck_swap_reset_lists, deck_swap_move_all_to_side, deck_swap_append_list_entry, deck_swap_remove_list_entry, ...).

Saves the editor block 0x00018d3c (save_write_edit_block) and the layout index (ui_select_layout_index of the current layout and pane modes, save_set_setting_b1_bits0_2). With write_deck non-zero: resets save card-list states 1-3 (array 0x00018fb0) to 0, writes list 0 to the deck struct (0x00018fa8) ids +0xc / count +0, list 1 to +0xa2 / +8 and list 2 to +0x84 / +4; card-list items (byte 4 bit 7) give the first free card-list item of the same id state 1 (main), 3 (extra) or 2 (side); other cards whose save state is 1 get save_clear_card_new. Returns nothing. Side effects: deck struct, card-list states, save edit block and settings, card new flags. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_message).

Per-frame input of the deck swap screen. Does nothing while bit 6 of 0x00018fe0 is set, while a network session reports an API error, or while bit 0 of 0x00018fa4 is set. Otherwise scrolls the card text (ui_scroll_card_text); when a message is open (bits 7-14 of 0x00018fe0) updates it (deck_swap_update_message), else dispatches on the state 0x00018cd4: 1, 7, 8 browse (deck_swap_handle_browse_input), 2 0x00008a88, 3 0x00006334, 4 0x0000a300, 5 0x0000319c, 6 0x0000b36c, then updates the cursor rectangle (ui_update_pane_cursor_rect). Returns nothing. Side effects: those handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update).

Browse-mode buttons. A d-pad repeat (pad +0xc & 0xf0) moves the cursor of the active pane (bits 4-5 of 0x00018fe0) with ui_move_pane_list_cursor or ui_move_pane_grid_cursor by the pane's layout bit (0x00019024 bit 0). Holding L sets state 7 and calls deck_swap_handle_scroll_input; holding R sets state 8 and calls deck_swap_handle_tool_input. Otherwise state 1: cancel opens message 2 when the totals of main, extra and side equal the deck struct's counts (+0, +8, +4), else message 3 (deck_swap_open_message, sound 0x7a0c); confirm starts a card move (0x000081f4, sound 0x7a05 on success); Triangle opens the command menu for the cursor entry (0x00006064, sound 0x7a08); Square cycles the pane's list (0x00007be0, sound 0x7a0d if the first entry changed); Select toggles the active pane's list layout and applies the new layout index (0x0000568c, sound 0x7a05). Returns nothing. Side effects: state word, pane records, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Hold-L handler (pad +0xc repeat bits): Square pages the active pane back (deck_swap_scroll_pane_page(1)), Circle forward (deck_swap_scroll_pane_page(0)), Triangle jumps to the previous sort group (ui_jump_pane_to_group(1)), Cross to the next (ui_jump_pane_to_group(0)), each with sound 0x7a04; a Select press (pad +4 bit 0) on a list whose filter field (list +0x16 bits 6-9) is set clears the filter (0x0000498c), re-sorts with the list's sort mode and order (deck_sort_list_view) and plays 0x7a05. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane scroll fields, list view, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

Hold-R handler (pad +4 presses): confirm starts a card move (0x000081f4, sound 0x7a05 on success); cancel toggles the save card byte-1 flag of the card under the cursor (save_test_card_byte1_flag / save_set_card_byte1_flag, sound 0x7a05); Square opens the sort menu (0x00009e60) and Triangle the filter menu (0x00002f00), sound 0x7a08; Select undoes the last move (0x00008698, sound 0x7a05) when the undo count 0x00018f4a is non-zero. Returns nothing. Side effects: those actions, save card flags, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

D-pad cursor movement for a pane in grid layout: Left/Right (pad +0xc bits 0x80/0x20) change the column (+8), Up/Down (0x10/0x40) the row (+0xa); moving past the first or last column hands over to the other pane with ui_switch_active_pane. Rows scroll the pane's first visible index (+6, in multiples of the column count) inside the list's entry count (list +0x14), wrapping from the top to the last row and back on a fresh Up/Down press (pad +4). Plays 0x7a04 when anything changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record 0x00019020 + 0x2c x pane, active-pane bits of 0x00018fe0 (through the switch), sound. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

D-pad cursor movement for a pane in list layout: Left (pad +0xc bit 0x80) switches to the other pane with ui_switch_active_pane(pane, rows, 1, row) and Right (0x20) with to_bottom 0; Up/Down (0x10/0x40) move the row (+0xa) and scroll the first visible index (+6) inside the entry count (list +0x14) using the visible-row count +0x18, wrapping on a fresh press (pad +4). Plays 0x7a04 when the cursor or scroll changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record 0x00019020 + 0x2c x pane, active-pane bits of 0x00018fe0, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

column2: void ui_switch_active_pane(int pane, uint old_rows, int from_left, uint old_row)
column3: Makes the other pane active: from pane 1 the target is pane 0; from pane 0 the target is pane 1 when the layout mode (low nibble of 0x00018fe0) is 2 or more, else pane 0 again. The target column (+8) becomes the last column when from_left is 1 and the target is in grid layout, else 0; the row (+0xa) is old_row rescaled from old_rows to the target's visible rows, clamped to rows - 1. Writes the target pane into bits 4-5 of 0x00018fe0. For any other pane value Ghidra shows a fifth register argument used as the target; both callers pass 0 or 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018fe0, target pane +8/+0xa. Callers: 2 (ui_move_pane_grid_cursor, ui_move_pane_list_cursor).

Pages the active pane: in grid layout by the visible rows (pane +0x26) in steps of the column count (pane +0x22), in list layout by the visible rows (pane +0x18); back = 1 scrolls up (clamped at 0), back = 0 down (clamped to the last full page). When the list fits on one page the first visible index (+6) becomes 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6 of the active pane. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_scroll_input).

Moves the active pane's cursor to the next (back = 0) or previous (back = 1) sort group: back is passed unchanged in a0 to ui_find_sort_group_index (Ghidra shows no parameter); with a non-negative index it sets the first visible index (+6), column (+8) and row (+0xa) so that the entry is visible, clamping the scroll to the last full page in grid layout and to count - visible rows in list layout. Does nothing for an empty list. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6/+8/+0xa of the active pane (records 0x00019020). Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_scroll_input).

Finds the view index of the neighbouring group in the active pane's list (pane records 0x00019020, view array list +0x10, entries list +4) under the list's sort mode (low nibble of list +0x16): the group key is 0x0000af70(entry, list, mode), divided by 100 for modes 4 and 5. Forward (back = 0) returns the first index after the cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_index) whose key differs, or -1 at the end; backward returns the first index of the previous group, 0 at the start or -1 at index 0; for modes 4-5 backward steps one entry. With no entry under the cursor returns count - 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_jump_pane_to_group).

Scrolls the card text of the detail panel. In layout modes below 4 (low nibble of 0x00018fe0) delegates to shop_scroll_with_analog(0x00018ffc). Otherwise, when the text width 0x00018fe4 is positive, moves the marquee offset 0x00018fe8 with the analog value at pad +0x10 (above 0xc0 forward by (v - 0xc0) x 6, clamped to the width; below 0x40 backward, clamped to 0), else auto-advances by 0x40 per frame once the delay counter 0x00018ff4 exceeds 0x35, and wraps at width + 0x76c0 (1/64 px units). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018fe8. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Computes the cursor rectangle of the active pane into the u16 globals 0x00018f9c (x), 0x00018f9e (y), 0x00018fa0 (width), 0x00018fa2 (height): in grid layout x = pane x + grid offset + column x column pitch, y likewise with the row pitch, size 0x17 x 0x1f; in list layout x = pane x + cell offset + 1, y = pane y + cell offset + 1 + row x row height, width = row width - 3, height = row height - 1, except pane 1 in layout modes below 4, which uses its own offsets without the +1 and width - 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018f9c-0x00018fa3. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Opens the message window (list window 0x000196a4, 0x120 bytes, text buffer 0x000197c4 of 0x800 bytes; reset first when one is open): fixed layout fields, then by type: 5 dictionary word 0x12 (resource 0x8033) with no buttons and the timeout counter 0x00019fc4 cleared; 4 word 0x53, or word 0x52 formatted with value when value is non-zero; 3 word 0xbc; 2 word 0xf with a two-choice layout. Opens it (ui_open_list_window) centred on the 480 x 272 screen and stores type in bits 7-14 of 0x00018fe0. Returns nothing. Side effects: window block, 0x00018fe0. Callers: 4 (deck_swap_tick, deck_swap_handle_browse_input, deck_swap_handle_filter_value_window, deck_swap_run_text_search).

Updates the message window 0x000196a4 (ui_update_list_window). Message type 5 closes itself after 0x2e frames while the state is below 9: commits without writing the deck (deck_swap_commit_lists(0)), fades out over 16 frames and sets state 9. When the window returns a result it is reset; type 2 with result 1 commits the lists (deck_swap_commit_lists, argument hidden by Ghidra; hypothesis medium: 1) and fades out to state 9; the message bits of 0x00018fe0 are cleared. Returns nothing. Side effects: window, state 0x00018cd4, save writes, fade. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Draws the message window 0x000196a4 of deck_swap_open_message / deck_swap_update_message (ui_draw_list_window with a pointer to list) and returns the possibly advanced list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

Opens the filter menu: allocates the 0x18-byte filter record 0x00019fc8 from heap 0x00018fb8 (+0 state, +2 sub-state, +3 bit 0 any marked card and bits 1-4 value column, +4 value row, +8 two-word value bitmask, +0x10 menu window, +0x14 value window) and a 0x120-byte list window at +0x10 (title dictionary word 0xa7 of resource 0x8033, 7 items of 0xa4 x 0x12 px, item callback deck_swap_draw_filter_menu_item at +0xfc), centred horizontally at y 0x3a. Scans card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 and sets +3 bit 0 when a valid card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked). Pre-selects the item of the active list's current filter (list +0x16 bits 6-9, minus 1, 0 when outside 0..6) in window +0xd2 and sets the state 0x00018cd4 = 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocations, 0x00019fc8, state word. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_swap_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame step of the filter menu (state 5) by the filter record state (0x00019fc8 +0): 0 updates the menu window; cancel (-2) starts closing it and goes to 2, a chosen item i clears the window's +200 bit 1, opens the value window for filter i + 1 (ui_open_filter_value_window), plays 0x7a08, clears cursor, column, bitmask and sub-state and goes to 1; 1 runs deck_swap_handle_filter_value_window; 2 waits for the menu window to close, frees the menu (ui_close_filter_menu) and returns to state 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, state 0x00018cd4, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Value-window step of the filter menu by sub-state (record +2): 0 input over a grid of the values first..last of the filter's 8-byte record in the table 0x000183c8 (u16 first, u16 last, draw callback; last value excluded for filter 7 without marked cards), column in record +3 bits 1-4, row in +4 low nibble (0xf = OK button); Up/Down/Left/Right move with wrap and sound 0x7a04; confirm on OK chooses item 0 and goes to 1, on a value toggles its bit in the bitmask at record +8 (sound 0x7a05); cancel closes the value window (sub-state 3, sound 0x7a06). 1 waits for the value window, then starts closing both (2). 2, once closed: an empty list only stores the filter number in list +0x16 bits 6-9, otherwise deck_filter_list_view(list, filter, bitmask) and ui_place_pane_cursor; then frees the menu, opens message 4 with the new view count and returns to state 1 (sound 0x7a0c). 3 resets the value window once closed, clears it from the record and returns the record to state 0 (menu input). Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, list view, pane cursor, state word, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_filter_menu).

Resets and frees the value window (+0x14, if any) and the menu window (+0x10) of the filter record, then the record itself, all from heap 0x00018fb8, and clears 0x00019fc8. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x00019fc8. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_update_filter_menu, deck_swap_handle_filter_value_window).

Draws the filter menu: in layout modes 2 and above first redraws the inactive pane (0x0000fb34 with that pane and its list's first entry id), then the menu window (record +0x10) and, when open, the value window (record +0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

column2: void * deck_swap_draw_filter_menu_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item callback of the filter menu window (+0xfc, called as (list, index, x, y)): tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x00018390 + (item + 1) x 6, x, y + 1, 0xa4, 0) and returns its advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores as the list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback set by deck_swap_open_filter_menu).

Allocates (or reuses) the 0x120-byte value window at filter record +0x14 and opens it for filter 1..7: x = the menu's centred x + 0x6d, y = menu y + 4 + filter x 0x12, width 0x8a, height 0x19 x ceil(count / 5) + 0x35 with count = last - first + 1 from the table 0x000183c8, cells 0x19 x 0x19, 5 columns (fewer when count < 5), item callback ui_draw_filter_value_items at +0x100; filter 7 uses 0xb7 x 0xe4, 6 columns and y = menu y - 0x16, filter 5 width 0xa3 and 6 columns, filter 3 0xa3 x 0x4e and 6 columns, filter 1 4 columns. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap allocation, record +0x14, window opened with ui_open_list_window. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_filter_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_filter_value_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item-draw callback of the filter value window (+0x100): draws the caption bar from resource 0x8006, the label of the value under the cursor (ui_get_filter_value_label, scale 0xc, white, fitted to width - 0x15), then for every value of the filter's range a check mark (ui_draw_filter_check_mark) when its bit is set in the record's bitmask, the cursor frame (0x18 x 0x18) on the selected cell and the value icon through the filter's draw callback in the table 0x000183cc (8-byte stride), and finally the OK button (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when row 0xf is selected) with dictionary word 0x20 centred in it. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) as a tail call (Ghidra shows an empty body). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void *deck_swap_draw_filter_icon_row(void *list, short x, short y, short index)
column3: Draws the 17 x 17 icon at u = index x 17, v = 0 of resource 0x800a at (x, y), white ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (hypothesis, medium: a draw callback of the filter table 0x000183c8).

column2: void *ui_draw_icon_grid_7col(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 icon from the texture of resource 0x800b: index % 7 across (u = (index % 7) x 17) and index / 7 down from v = 0x33, white ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (hypothesis, medium: a draw callback of the filter table 0x000183c8).

column2: void *deck_swap_draw_filter_icon_16(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 16 x 16 icon: values below 11 from resource 0x800c at ((index & 7) x 16, (index >> 3) x 16); values 11 and 12 from resource 0x800a at the (u, v) pairs at 0x00018410; values above 12 as index - 2 in the 0x800c grid. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when a resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (hypothesis, medium: a draw callback of the filter table 0x000183c8).

column2: void *ui_draw_table_icon_a(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x00018390 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_pane_status).

Draws the 26 x 26 check-mark sprite at texture (0x9a, 0xc0) of resource 0x8006 at (x, y). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Returns the UTF-16 label of value of filter: 1 dictionary word (resource 0x8033) from the u16 table 0x00018418, 2 card_db_get_race_name, 3 card_db_get_attribute_name, 4 word from the table 0x00018428, 5 from the table 0x00018430 offset by 4 entries, 6 from 0x00018430, 7 card_db_get_genre_name; NULL for other filters. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Resets a list's view to all entries in entry order (view array +0x10, count +0x14 = entry count +8), clears the filter field (bits 6-9 of +0x16) and re-sorts it (deck_sort_list_view(list, 1, 0)). Returns the view count. Side effects: list view. Callers: 4 (deck_swap_finish_command_menu, deck_swap_handle_layout_submenu, deck_swap_handle_scroll_input, deck_swap_run_text_search).

Starts a text search over an editor list: clears the 0x14-byte search state at 0x00019fcc, stores the list's view count (+0x14) at 0x00019fce and text at 0x00019fd8, allocates a result array (count x 2 bytes) at 0x00019fd4 and a 0x10000-byte Horspool shift table filled with 0xff at 0x00019fdc (heap 0x00018fb8). Returns nothing. Side effects: search state, heap. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_run_text_search).

Advances the running text search by up to 48 view entries of list: appends the entry indices whose card matches (deck_card_matches_search_text with the text 0x00019fd8) to the result array 0x00019fd4 (count 0x00019fd0); returns progress in permille (position x 1000 / total), 1000 when finished or without a result array. Side effects: search state. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_run_text_search).

Ends a text search: frees the shift table, copies the result indices into the list's view (+0x10, count +0x14) and frees them, sets the view mode bits 6-9 of +0x16 to 8, and moves the search text to the front of the 8-entry history of 0x40-byte UTF-16 strings at 0x00018d3c (the save's edit block), removing a duplicate. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, history, heap frees. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_run_text_search).

Filters the list's view in place: keeps the view entries for which the predicate at 0x0001844c + 4 x filter returns non-zero (called with the card id and args[0]); filter 7 uses deck_filter_by_genre(entry, args); stores the new view count at +0x14 and filter in bits 6-9 of +0x16. Returns the new view count. Side effects: list view, temporary heap buffer. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_filter_value_window).
Filter predicate: true when bit shop_get_frame_style_index(card_db_get_frame(card_id)) of mask is set. No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_race(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_attribute(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).

Filter predicate: builds a level mask by OR-ing the u16 masks at 0x00018470, 0x00018472, 0x00018474 for mask bits 0, 1, 2 and returns 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_level(card_id) of that mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).

Filter predicate on frame and icon: frame 8 (trap) with icon 4 -> mask bit 0x100, icon 1 -> 0x80, icon 0 -> 0x200; frame 7 (spell) with icon 0 -> 0x40, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 4, 4 -> 8, 5 -> 0x10, 6 -> 0x20; returns 1 when that bit of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).

Filter predicate: true when bit deck_get_current_card_limit(card_id) of mask is set (the save's current limit list; unlike rel_deck there is no other-deck case). No side effects. No direct caller (predicate table 0x0001844c).

Filter 7: true when masks[0] bit 0 is set and the card is new (save_get_card_state 1); or masks[1] bit 6 is set and the card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked) with artworks (ui_count_card_artworks with resource 0x8032); or its genre words (card_db_get_genres) intersect the requested genre bits. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_list_view).

Normalises text (deck_normalize_search_text) and searches it with deck_search_text_horspool in, successively, the card name without ruby, the name's ruby reading, the description without ruby and the description's ruby reading (system_font_strip_ruby / system_font_extract_ruby_reading); true on the first match. No side effects beyond the stack buffers and the shift table. Callers: 1 (deck_step_text_search).

Boyer-Moore-Horspool search of a UTF-16 pattern of length units in text, using the 64K-entry byte shift table 0x00019fdc (0xff means the full length); resets the used entries with deck_clear_search_shift_table. Returns a pointer to the match in text, or 0. Side effects: shift table. Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).
Resets the Horspool shift-table entries used by a search pattern: table[pattern[i]] = 0xff for i < length - 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes table. Callers: 1 (deck_search_text_horspool).

Copies the UTF-16 string in to out normalised for searching: full-width forms 0xff01-0xff5d become ASCII (+0x120 modulo 0x10000), katakana 0x30a1-0x30f4 become hiragana (-0x60), other characters go through system_towupper; NUL-terminates out. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).

Switches the screen to layout 0-7: saves the pane cursors into their lists (ui_store_pane_cursors, pane 0 only in single-pane modes, both otherwise), takes pane 0's list-layout flag and geometry from the 8-byte layout record 0x00018510 + 8 x layout (s16 pane-0 flag, s16 pane-0 geometry, s16 pane-1 flag, s16 pane-1 geometry, -1 = unchanged) by copying the 0x1e-byte geometry record 0x00018478 + 0x1e x index to pane +0xc (pane 1 to 0x00019058), stores layout in the low nibble of 0x00018fe0 and restores each pane's scroll and cursor from its list (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x1a, +0x1d) with ui_place_pane_cursor. Going to a single-pane layout while pane 1 was active makes pane 0 active and shows pane 1's list there; going to two panes moves pane 0's list (index >= 2) to pane 1 and shows list 0 in pane 0. Then plays the tab frame (deck_swap_play_tab_frame) and reloads the cursor card text when there is an entry (deck_swap_load_cursor_card_text). Returns nothing. Side effects: pane records 0x00019020/0x0001904c, 0x00018fe0, list cursor fields. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_init_editor, deck_swap_handle_browse_input); also reached by the tail jump deck_swap_apply_layout_choice.

column2: int ui_select_layout_index(short pane_count, int narrow, short pane0_list_layout, short pane1_list_layout)
column3: Maps a layout description to the layout index 0-7: one pane gives 0 with list layout (flag 1) and 1 with grid layout (flag 0); two narrow panes (layout modes 2-3) give 2 (grid, grid) or 3 (grid, list); two wide panes (modes 4-7) give 5 (grid, grid), 7 (grid, list), 6 (list, grid) or 4 (list, list). Returns -1 for any other combination. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_swap_commit_lists, deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

Selects the 10-byte tab record of tab from the table for the current layout group (0x00018550 for layout modes 0-1, 0x0001856e for 2-3, 0x0001858c for 4-7) and returns its first two u16 fields masked to 9 bits: the tab's x offset in the low half and its width in the high half (deck_swap_get_slot_position takes pane x + low + high / 2 as the tab centre). No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_get_slot_position, deck_swap_draw_pane_shade).

column2: uint deck_swap_calc_list_tab_rect(ushort tab, ushort active_tab, ushort *rect)
column3: Fills rect (x, y, width, height as u16) with the area of the tab's card count, passed to ui_draw_list_tab_count (rel_deck's ui_calc_list_tab_rect), from the layout group's tab record (see deck_swap_get_tab_position): x = record +4, width = record +6 (9 bits each), y 0x19 and height 0xd when tab == active_tab, else y 0x1b and height 0xb. Returns the x at which the digits end: x + width - (width - 8 n) / 2 - 1, with n the 5-bit value in bits 1-5 of byte +7 (hypothesis, medium: n is the digit count, so this is the right end of a block centred in the rect). Side effects: rect. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_list_tabs).

Fills rect (x, y, width, height as u16) with the area of the tab's label, passed to ui_draw_list_tab_label (rel_deck's ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow): 0x22 pixels wide ending at the tab record's x (+4 - 0x22), y 0x19 / height 0xd for the active tab, y 0x1b / height 0xb otherwise. Returns nothing. Side effects: rect. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_list_tabs).
Returns the EHF frame for the list kind shown in pane 0: kind + 0x27 in layout modes 0-1, kind + 0x2a in 2-3, kind + 0x2c in 4-7. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_play_tab_frame).

Sets the play range of the tab animation (resource 0x8022, ui_ehf_set_play_range) to frame deck_swap_get_tab_frame(kind of pane 0's list) .. frame + 1, then refreshes the count indicators (deck_swap_update_count_indicators). Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF state. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_set_layout, deck_swap_cycle_pane_list).

Compares the main total (list 0 +0xc) with the deck struct's main count and the extra total (list 1) with its extra count: 0 equal, 1 the list has more, 2 fewer; with the layout group (0, 1, 2) selects a 4-byte (start, end) pair from 0x000185ac (main, resource 0x1010) and 0x000185d0 (extra, resource 0x1011) and sets those EHF play ranges. Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF state. Callers: 4 (deck_swap_init_editor, deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_play_tab_frame, deck_swap_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Opens the card command menu: allocates the 0x18-byte record 0x00019fe0 (+0 bit 0 no card, +2 state, +4 entry, +8 layout, +0x10 main window, +0x14 submenu) and a 0x120-byte list window (title word 0x11 of resource 0x8033, items 0xe8 x 0x13, drawer deck_swap_draw_command_menu_items at +0x100) with 7 items, or 5 items and the first two (card commands) dropped when entry is NULL. Disables (window +0xdc mask) the undo item when the undo count 0x00018f4a is 0 and the clear-filter item when the active list has no filter. Widens to at least 0xe8, centres it and sets the state 0x00018cd4 = 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, record, window, state word. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

Per-frame step of the command menu (state 3) by the record state (+2): 0 deck_swap_handle_command_choice, 1 deck_swap_handle_list_tools_submenu, 2 deck_swap_handle_deck_options_submenu, 3 deck_swap_handle_layout_submenu, 10 deck_swap_finish_command_menu. Returns 0. Side effects: those handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Draws the command menu window (record 0x00019fe0 +0x10) and, when open, its submenu window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

Resets and frees the submenu window (+0x14, if any) and the main window (+0x10) of the command menu record, frees the record from heap 0x00018fb8 and clears 0x00019fe0. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x00019fe0. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_swap_finish_command_menu).

Updates the command menu window; item numbers are shifted by 2 when the menu has no card. Items 5 (clear filter), 6 (undo) or cancel start closing the window and set record state 10. Item 0 sets bit 0 of 0x00018fa4, which blocks deck_swap_handle_input and makes deck_swap_tick run the card viewer (deck_swap_run_card_viewer); 1 toggles the card's save byte-1 flag (save_set_card_byte1_flag); 2 opens the list-tools submenu (state 1), 3 the deck-options submenu (state 2), 4 the layout submenu (state 3), each with sound 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: record, window, 0x00018fa4, save card flag, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_command_menu).

Waits until the command menu window has closed (window +0xe9 != 5), frees the menu (ui_close_card_command_menu), then for item 6 runs undo (0x00008698; returns early while it is busy) and for item 5 clears the active list's filter (deck_swap_reset_list_view) and re-sorts it (deck_sort_list_view); then sets the state 0x00018cd4 = 1. Returns 0. Side effects: menu freed, list view, state word. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_command_menu).

column2: int ui_open_command_submenu(ushort title, ushort caption, short item_count, void *item_callback)
column3: Prepares the command menu's submenu window (record +0x14; allocated as 0x120 bytes from heap 0x00018fb8 when absent): cleared, placed right of the main window, caption word caption at +0x84 and title word title at +0xa0 (when non-zero), items 0xe8 x 0x13, item_count at +0xcc and the item-label callback at +0xfc. Does not open it. Returns 1, or 0 when the allocation failed. Side effects: heap, submenu window. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_open_deck_options_submenu, ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_swap_open_list_tools_submenu).

Opens the list-tools submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x4d, no caption, 3 items, deck_swap_draw_list_tools_item), sets window +200 bit 3 and opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_command_choice).

Updates the list-tools submenu; on a result it starts closing it (and the main window for items 0-2), and when closed frees it: cancel returns the record to state 0; item 0 opens the sort menu (0x00009e60), 1 the filter menu (deck_swap_open_filter_menu), 2 the text search (0x0000b140), each with sound 0x7a08 and closing the command menu (ui_close_card_command_menu). Returns nothing. Side effects: windows, heap, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_command_menu).

Opens the deck-options submenu: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x10, no caption, 2 items, deck_swap_draw_deck_options_item) and opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_command_choice).

Updates the deck-options submenu; on a result frees it. Item 0 restores the lists from the deck struct (deck_swap_reset_lists), item 1 moves every main and extra card to the side list (deck_swap_move_all_to_side); both clear the undo count 0x00018f4a, refresh the count indicators, start closing the main window and set record state 10. Cancel returns to record state 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, undo count, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_command_menu).

Opens the layout chooser: ui_open_command_submenu(title 0x45) resized with a custom item drawer at +0x100; the current layout (ui_select_layout_index of pane count, narrow flag and the panes' list-layout flags) is stored at record +8 and pre-selected; record +0xa/+0xc keep the inactive pane number and its list kind. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window, record +8..+0xd. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_command_choice).

Layout chooser input over a 4 x 2 grid (window +0xd2 low 3 bits): Up/Down (pad +0xc 0x50) toggle the row, Left/Right step the column with wrap, each previewing the layout at once (deck_swap_apply_layout_choice) with sound 0x7a04; confirm chooses the item (sound 0x7a05); cancel marks +0xe8 bit 0, starts closing (sound 0x7a06). When the window has closed: after cancel the saved layout (record +8) is re-applied, the submenu freed and record state 0 restored; otherwise, when leaving a two-pane layout for a single-pane one, the list kept in record +0xc gets its view reset (deck_swap_reset_list_view), and the main window starts closing (record state 10). Returns nothing. Side effects: layout, windows, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_command_menu).

column2: void *shop_draw_menu_separator(void *list, void *verts, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Fills four 12-byte vertices in verts (colour, x, y, z) for two horizontal lines from x to x + width: colour 0xff479fc1 at y and 0xffa9d7e9 at y + 1; disables texturing, draws them as lines and re-enables texturing. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands, verts. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_command_menu_items).

Window drawer (+0x100) of the command menu: with a card, draws its thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb with resources 0x8001, 0x8002, 0x8032) at (x + 2, y + 2) and, when its save byte-1 flag is set, the check icon (shop_draw_check_icon, resource 0x800a); then for each item (7, or 5 without a card) the cursor frame on the selected one, the label (deck_swap_draw_command_item_label, items 0 and 1 indented by 0x1d) and a separator line (shop_draw_menu_separator) after items 1 and 4. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by deck_swap_open_command_menu).

column2: void deck_swap_draw_command_item_label(void *list, uint item, uint offset, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Draws command item item with ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x000185f4 + item x 6, x, y + 1, width, colour), the colour being 0xff808080 (greyed) for items 5 and 6 when bit (item - offset) of the window's disabled mask (+0xdc) is set, else 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_command_menu_items).

column2: void * deck_swap_draw_layout_choices(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Drawer of the layout submenu (window +0x100, called by ui_draw_list_window as (list, x, y, width, height); width and height are not used): draws the cursor frame over the selected cell of a grid of 0x28 x 0x18 cells (window +0xd2: low 2 bits column, bits 2-4 row), then the 8 layout icons (32 x 16, resource 0x800a at u = (i / 4) x 32 + 0x40, v = (i % 4) x 16 + 0x40) in 2 rows of 4. Returns the advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores as the list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (installed at +0x100 by ui_open_layout_submenu).

column2: void deck_swap_draw_list_tools_item(void *list, uint item, int y, int x)
column3: Item callback of the list-tools submenu: builds a 16-byte item (icon texture resource from the 6-byte record 0x00018620 + 6 x item, u and v bytes, size 17 x 17, label dictionary word from record +4) and draws it with shop_draw_menu_item_box(list, item, y, x + 1, 0xe8). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc).

column2: void deck_swap_draw_deck_options_item(void *list, uint item, int y, int x)
column3: Item callback of the deck-options submenu: same as deck_swap_draw_list_tools_item with the records at 0x00018634. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc).

Tail jump to deck_swap_set_layout(layout); Ghidra shows the target's body under this 8-byte entry. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of deck_swap_set_layout. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_layout_submenu).

Initialises the screen once resources are loaded: builds the lists (deck_swap_init_lists), reads the save's edit block into 0x00018d3c (save_read_edit_block), makes pane 1 active with pane 0 on list 0 (main, 0x00018cdc) and pane 1 on list 2 (side, 0x00018d1c), applies the saved layout (save_get_setting_b1_bits0_2, deck_swap_set_layout), refreshes the count indicators, opens the card view (ui_card_view_open with resources 0x8007, 0x8009, 0x8024, 0x8011, 0x8010 and the card reader 0x00018fbc) and clears the card-text state 0x00018ff0-0x00018fff. Returns nothing. Side effects: lists, panes, card view. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_resource_load).

Returns the view index under the cursor of pane: first visible index (+6) + column (+8) + row (+0xa) x columns (+0x22) in grid layout, first visible index + row in list layout (pane records 0x00019020). No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_get_pane_cursor_entry, ui_draw_sort_group_header, ui_find_sort_group_index, deck_swap_start_card_move).

Returns the 6-byte list entry under pane's cursor (list entries +4 indexed through the view array +0x10 at ui_get_pane_cursor_index(pane)), or NULL when the index is not below the view count (+0x14). No side effects. Callers: 7 (deck_swap_run_card_viewer, deck_swap_tick, deck_swap_handle_tool_input, deck_swap_start_card_move, ...).

Loads the card under the active pane's cursor into the text panel: stores the entry pointer (0x00018ff8), id (0x00018ff0) and image index (0x00018ff2), measures card_db_get_description at scale 0xc and stores the width beyond 0x4f40 (1/64 px) in 0x00018fe4 (0 when it fits), resets the marquee 0x00018fe8 and the delay 0x00018ff4, and in layout modes 0-3 sets the text-scroll record 0x00018ffc to the id. Without an entry or with id 0 clears those fields (0x00018ffc = -1). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018fe4-0x00019007. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_tick, deck_swap_set_layout).

column2: void deck_swap_cycle_pane_list(ushort pane, uint list, short dir)
column3: Changes the list shown in a pane: dir 1 next, 0 previous, other values select list directly. In single-pane modes pane 0 cycles lists 0-2; in two-pane modes pane 0 cycles lists 0-1 (main, extra) and pane 1 always shows list 2 (side). When the list changes it stores the cursors (ui_store_pane_cursors), points the pane at list record 0x00018cdc + 0x20 x list, restores and re-clamps its scroll/column/row (ui_place_pane_cursor) and plays the tab frame. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record, list cursor fields, EHF. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_set_layout, deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

column2: void ui_place_pane_cursor(short keep_cursor, uint index, uint geometry, uint count, ushort *top, ushort *column, ushort *row)
column3: Clamps a pane's scroll and cursor to a list of count entries; geometry holds the columns in the low byte and the visible rows in the high byte. For count below 2 the first visible index becomes 0; otherwise *top is pulled back when the window runs past the end or set to 0 when everything fits. The target index is index, or with keep_cursor = 1 the current cursor index clamped to count - 1; it is then made visible and *column / *row are recomputed. Returns nothing. Side effects: *top, *column, *row. Callers: 6 (deck_swap_run_text_search, deck_swap_handle_filter_value_window, deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_move_all_to_side, ...).

Saves pane cursors into the lists they show: for which != 1 pane 0 (list 0x00019020), for which != 0 pane 1 (list 0x0001904c): first visible index to list +0x18, column and row nibbles to +0x1c, the absolute cursor index to +0x1a and the column count (1 in list layout) to the low nibble of +0x1d. Returns nothing. Side effects: list records +0x18..+0x1d. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_set_layout, deck_swap_cycle_pane_list).

Pushes a 10-byte move record on the undo stack 0x00018f4c (8 entries, count 0x00018f4a): below 8 entries it is stored at the top and the count incremented; when full the entries are shifted down by one and the record replaces the last. Returns nothing. Side effects: undo stack and count. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_start_card_move).

When the undo count 0x00018f4a is non-zero decrements it and copies the 10-byte record at the new top of 0x00018f4c to out. Returns true when a record was popped. Side effects: undo count, *out. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_start_undo_move).

Starts moving the card under the active pane's cursor: returns 0 without an entry. Allocates the 0x34-byte move record 0x00019fe4 (byte 0 low nibble state, high nibble sub-step; +1 frame counter; +2 entry index; +4 view index; u16 +6: bits 0-1 source pane, 2-4 source list, 5-6 target pane, 7-9 target list; +8 list shown by the other pane; +0xe copy of the 6-byte entry; +0x14 scroll wait; floats +0x18 start, +0x20 control point, +0x28 end; +0x30/+0x32 drawn position). Target list: from list 2 (side) list 1 (extra) for card_db_get_frame 3 or 10, else list 0 (main); from lists 0 and 1 list 2; any other source frees the record and returns 0. The target pane is the same pane in single-pane layouts, else the other one. Pushes an undo record (deck_swap_push_undo: lists byte, target view count, entry), sets state 0x00018cd4 = 2, computes the start and end positions (deck_swap_get_slot_position, scrolling the target pane if needed: move state 1, else 2) and removes one copy from the source list (deck_swap_remove_card_move_source). Returns 1. Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, lists, state word. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_handle_tool_input, deck_swap_handle_browse_input).

Pops the last undo record (deck_swap_pop_undo); returns 0 when the stack is empty or the allocation fails. Builds a move record that goes from the recorded target list back to the recorded source list (panes chosen as in deck_swap_start_card_move), finds the moved entry in the source list (the recorded index if it still holds the same id and card-list flag, else the last entry with that id and flag, else -1) and its view index, computes the start position, removes one copy (deck_swap_remove_card_move_source) and enters move state 2 with state 0x00018cd4 = 2. Returns 1. Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, lists, state word. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_finish_command_menu, deck_swap_handle_tool_input).

Card-move step (state 2) by the move record's low nibble: 3 frees the record (deck_swap_free_card_move) and returns to state 1; 2 runs the flight (deck_swap_animate_card_move); 1 counts frames up to the scroll wait (+0x14 bits 0-2), then recomputes the end position with scrolling (deck_swap_get_slot_position) and, once the slot is visible, records the start position and goes to 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: move record, state word, pane scroll. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Removes one copy of the moving card from its source list: deck_swap_remove_list_entry(list record 0x00018cdc + 0x20 x source list, record +2). Returns nothing. Side effects: source list. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_start_undo_move, deck_swap_start_card_move).

Copies the moved entry (record +0xe), sets its copies to 1 (flag 0x80 kept) and byte 5 bit 0, and appends it to the target list (deck_swap_append_list_entry). Returns nothing. Side effects: target list. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_animate_card_move).

Flight of a moving card by the record's high nibble: 0 computes the end position and the control point of a quadratic Bezier curve (midpoint offset by 120 px horizontally or 68 px vertically, or a corner point when both coordinates differ by more than 10); 1 for 10 frames sets the drawn position +0x30/+0x32 to B(t) with t = frame / 10; 2 in single-pane layouts first shows the target list in the pane (deck_swap_cycle_pane_list), drops the card (deck_swap_drop_card_move), recounts frames, refreshes the count indicators, re-clamps both panes' cursors (ui_place_pane_cursor) and sets move state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: move record, lists, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_card_move).

Frees the move record 0x00019fe4 from heap 0x00018fb8 when allocated and clears the pointer. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, 0x00019fe4. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_start_undo_move, deck_swap_update_card_move, deck_swap_start_card_move).

While the move record is in flight (state 2) draws the moving card's thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb with resources 0x8001, 0x8002, 0x8032) at the drawn position (+0x30 - 0xb, +0x32 - 0xf). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

column2: int deck_swap_get_slot_position(float *out, int pane, uint list, int index, int scroll)
column3: Computes the centre (x + 11, y + 15) of slot index of list in pane (records 0x00019020) into out[0..1]: in list layout x = pane x + cell x offset, y = pane y + cell y offset + row height x (index - first visible) (+1 for pane 1 in layout modes below 4); in grid layout from the column and row pitches. When the pane does not show list, out is the list's tab position (deck_swap_get_tab_position, y 32). When index is outside the visible window and scroll is non-zero, scrolls the pane by one row (columns in grid layout), stores a wait of 6 (grid) or 1 (list) frames in move record +0x14 and returns 0; with scroll 0 it falls back to the tab position. Returns 1 when out was written. Side effects: out, pane scroll, move record +0x14. Callers: 4 (deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_start_undo_move, deck_swap_update_card_move, deck_swap_start_card_move).
Returns the view count (+0x14) of list record 0x00018cdc + 0x20 x list. No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_animate_card_move, deck_swap_update_card_move, deck_swap_start_card_move).

Per-frame tick of the deck swap screen. With a network session active it decrements the time limit 0x00018fb4; when it reaches 0 in a state below 9, with input not blocked and no time-out message shown, it finishes the fade, clears the viewer flags (0x0001901c, 0x00018fa4 bit 0) and opens message 5 (deck_swap_open_message). Without the card viewer (0x00018fa4 bit 0 clear) it counts the frames the cursor stays on a card (0x00018ff4; after 16 frames sets byte 5 bit 0 of the entry, the looked-at mark) and reloads the card text when the cursor card changed (deck_swap_load_cursor_card_text, unless 0x00018fec bit 0); otherwise it runs deck_swap_run_card_viewer. Returns nothing. Side effects: timer, entries, card text, message. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update).

Card viewer sub-state machine on 0x00018cd8: 0 fades out (16 frames); 1 when the fade is done opens the viewer for the cursor card (ui_card_viewer_open(id, resource 0x800c, resource 0x8012), ui_card_viewer_set_pack_source(resource 0x8015), ui_card_viewer_enable_artwork_select) and sets 0x0001901c bit 0; 2 runs ui_card_viewer_update until it returns non-zero, then clears that bit and fades in; 3 waits for the fade and clears 0x00018cd8 and bit 0 of 0x00018fa4. Returns nothing. Side effects: fades, card viewer, flags. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_tick).
Comparator: returns *a - *b (u16 values, ascending). No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by deck_swap_begin_resource_load).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Binary search of count 12-byte resource records (u16 id at +0, sorted ascending) for id. Returns the record index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_get_resource).

Starts the resource loader: clears the loader byte 0x00019ff0 and sets bit 0 (idle), and sorts the resource tables 0x0001891c (0x29 records of 12 bytes) and 0x00018b30 (2 records) by id (system_qsort with deck_compare_u16_ascending). Returns nothing. Side effects: loader byte, tables. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_start).

While the loader is idle (0x00019ff0 bit 0), steps on the loaded-file count in bits 1-7: 0 requests the first resource file (deck_swap_load_resource_file, group argument hidden by Ghidra), 1 requests group 2, 2 or more initialises the screen (deck_swap_init_editor), resets the count and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: file loads, editor set-up. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update).

Frees the two resource files loaded into the 12-byte records of 0x00018664 (pointer at +4) from heap 0x00018fb8 and clears the pointers. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_release_resources).

Looks group up in the 2-record file table 0x00018664 (u16 group, pointer, path format). Returns the loaded file when already present; otherwise, when the loader is idle, formats the path with the language letter (string "jegfis" indexed by save_get_language), clears the idle bit, allocates container_get_file_size(3, path) bytes and starts container_load_file(3, path, buffer, size, shop_on_archive_loaded, buffer); returns 0. Side effects: heap, file load, loader byte 0x00019ff0, table pointer. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_update_resource_load, deck_swap_get_resource).

Returns the archive member for resource id: ids with bit 0x8000 are searched in the 0x29-record table 0x0001891c, ids with bit 0x1000 in the 2-record table 0x00018b30 (12 bytes: u16 id, u16 file group, cached pointer, member-name format). On a cache miss it gets the resource file (deck_swap_load_resource_file; 0 while loading), formats the member name with the language letter (ids 0x8036-0x8037 with a fixed letter from 0x00018b48) and finds it with container_ehp_find_member, caching the pointer. Returns the member pointer or 0. Side effects: cache in the table, file loads. Callers: 52 (deck_swap_draw_search_input_box, ui_draw_filter_check_mark, deck_swap_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_swap_draw_cursor_card_info, ...).

Archive load callback: when size > 0 binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, ehp) if ehp is set) and increments the loaded counter in bits 1-7 of 0x00019ff0; always sets bit 0 (idle). Returns true when size > 0. Side effects: EHP binding, 0x00019ff0. No direct caller (callback passed to container_load_file by deck_swap_load_resource_file).

Opens the sort menu for the active pane's list: allocates the 0x18-byte record 0x00019ff4 (+0 state, +1 focused window, +4 view backup, +8 saved sort mode (bits 0-5) and order (bits 6-7), +0xc content bottom, +0x10 key window, +0x14 order window) with a key window (title word 0xa8, 10 items of 0x88 x 0x12, item callback deck_swap_draw_sort_key_item) and an order window to its right (2 items sized to the wider of words 0x61/0x62, callback deck_swap_draw_sort_order_item), copies the view array as backup, pre-selects the current mode and order, positions the order window (shop_place_sort_order_window), sets state 0x00018cd4 = 4 and bit 0 of 0x00018fec (freezes the card text). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, windows, state word. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_swap_handle_tool_input).

Sort-menu step (state 4): in record state 0 updates the focused window (Right moves focus to the order window, Left back, L/R toggle the order) with sound 0x7a04; when the key or order selection changed it restores the view backup and re-sorts (deck_sort_list_view(list, key + 1, order)) as a live preview. On a result both windows start closing (record state 1): cancel (-2) restores the view and the saved mode/order bits of list +0x16, confirm re-sorts with the choice. In record state 1, once closed, frees the menu (shop_close_results_sort_menu), returns to state 1 and clears 0x00018fec bit 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view and sort bits, windows, state word, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Resets the two list windows of the sort menu record 0x00019ff4 (+0x14, +0x10), frees both and the record from heap 0x00018fb8 and clears 0x00019ff4. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x00019ff4. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_sort_menu).

Draws the sort menu: in layout modes 2 and above first redraws the inactive pane (0x0000fb34), then the key window (+0x10) and the order window (+0x14) of record 0x00019ff4 with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

column2: void * deck_swap_draw_sort_key_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item callback of the sort key window (+0xfc, called as (list, index, x, y)): tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x00018b50 + (item + 1) x 6, x, y + 1, 0x88, 0) and returns its advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores as the list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_swap_open_sort_menu).

column2: void * deck_swap_draw_sort_order_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Item callback of the sort order window (+0xfc, called as (list, index, x, y)): tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x00018b94 + item x 6, x, y + 1, window width +0xf0, 0) and returns its advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores as the list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_swap_open_sort_menu).

Positions the order window (+0x14) of the sort menu record 0x00019ff4 vertically next to the selected item of the key window (+0x10): y = record +0xc + item height / 2 + selected item x item height minus a term from the order window height (+0x6e). Returns nothing. Side effects: order window +0x5a. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_open_sort_menu, deck_swap_update_sort_menu).

column2: void *ui_draw_table_icon_a_2(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x00018b50 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id, u8 u, u8 v), the sort-key icon table. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_pane_status).

column2: void *shop_draw_sort_order_icon(void *list, int key, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the 17 x 17 icon of the sort order key: resource id u16 at 0x00018b94 + key x 6, texture offset bytes +2/+3, white ambient, nearest filter. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_pane_status).

column2: void deck_sort_list_view(void *list, int mode, int order)
column3: Sorts the list's view: builds 8-byte records {view index, position, deck_swap_get_card_sort_key(entry, list, mode)}, sorts them with system_qsort using deck_swap_compare_sort_ascending (order 0) or deck_swap_compare_sort_descending (order 1), writes the view back and stores mode and order in the low nibble and bits 4-5 of list +0x16. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, heap temporary. Callers: 6 (deck_swap_finish_command_menu, deck_swap_reset_list_view, deck_swap_handle_scroll_input, deck_swap_init_lists, ...).

qsort comparator for 8-byte sort records: compares the s32 key at +4 ascending, key -2 (no key) always last, equal keys by the u16 at +2 ascending. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed by deck_sort_list_view).

qsort comparator for 8-byte sort records: key at +4 descending, key -2 always last, equal keys by the u16 at +2 descending. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed by deck_sort_list_view).

Sort key of an entry for sort mode: 10 copies (0xffff minus the entry's copies for list kind 3, else minus deck_swap_count_list_card), 9 deck_get_current_card_limit, 2 card_db_get_frame, 1 card_db_get_sort_position; traps (frame 8) and spells (frame 7) in mode 8 map card_db_get_icon through the byte tables 0x00018ba8 / 0x00018ba0, otherwise -2; other cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 0xffff - DEF (0x10000 for '?'), 4 0xffff - ATK, 3 0xffff - level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_sort_list_view).

Group value of an entry for sort mode: 10 copies (entry copies for list kind 3, else deck_swap_count_list_card total), 9 deck_get_current_card_limit, 2 frame, 1 card_db_get_top_group; spells and traps give their icon (0 -> 7) for mode 8, else -2; other cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 DEF and 4 ATK (-1 for '?'), 3 level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_find_sort_group_index, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

Opens the text-search menu: allocates the 0x60-byte record 0x00019ff8 and a 0x120-byte window at +0x4c (x 0x5e, y 0x38, width 0x124, title word 0xa5, caption word 0x81, drawer 0x0000c5e8 at +0x100); when the active list has a filter sets +0x48 = 0x27 and opens the filter display windows (ui_open_search_filter_windows); sizes the window to its content plus +0x48, prepares the entry state (0x0000bc24) and sets state 0x00018cd4 = 6. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, windows, state word. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Per-frame step of the text search (state 6) by the record state (0x00019ff8 +0; record +4 focus bits 0-1, +6 UTF-16 query, +0x4c main, +0x50 history, +0x54 progress window): 0 input: Triangle toggles the scope (ui_toggle_search_scope), Left/Right move the focus between the query box (0) and OK (2), Down on the box with a history window goes to 1; confirm on OK chooses it (0x7a05, state 2), confirm on the box opens the on-screen keyboard on the query (ui_start_osk_input(query, word 0x80, 0x10, deck_swap_on_search_text_entered)) and on success sets bit 6 of 0x00018fe0 (screen captured for the OSK) and clears bit 5 of 0x0001901c; cancel marks the main window cancelled, starts closing it and the filter windows (0x7a06, state 3). 1 history list: a chosen entry copies history string 0x00018d3c + 0x40 x n into the query and focuses OK; cancel or Up on the first entry returns to 0. 2 waits for the choose animation, then closes everything (3). 3 when the main window has closed: if cancelled frees the menu (ui_close_text_search_menu) and returns to state 1, otherwise resets the windows and runs the search (record state 4, deck_swap_run_text_search). Returns nothing. Side effects: search record, windows, 0x00018fe0, state word, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_handle_input).

Runs the search on the active pane's list, stepped by record +2: 0 with an empty query sets the list's filter field (list +0x16 bits 6-9) to 8 and goes to step 10; otherwise, when the list is filtered and the scope 0x00018fa6 is 1, clears the filter first (deck_swap_reset_list_view); with entries it starts the search (deck_begin_text_search(list, query)), resets the progress and opens the progress window (step 1), without entries it begins and finishes at once (step 10). 1 waits for the progress window to open; 2 runs deck_step_text_search and stores the per-mille progress at +0x46, moving on at 1000; 3 finishes (deck_swap_finish_text_search), resets the pane cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor) and closes the progress window; 4 waits for it to close; then (also from 10) frees the menu, opens message 4 with the list's new view count, plays 0x7a0c and returns to state 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view, search state, windows, state word. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Resets and frees the progress (+0x54) and history (+0x50) windows, releases and frees the two filter windows, resets and frees the main window (+0x4c) and finally the search record, clearing 0x00019ff8 (heap 0x00018fb8). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x00019ff8. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_run_text_search, deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Counts the non-empty entries of the 8 x 0x40-byte search history at 0x00018d3c; with none returns 0. Otherwise allocates (or reuses) the history window (record +0x50) and opens it below the main window (x + 6, y = content bottom + 0xf + extra height +0x48), items 0xb0 x 0xe, one per entry, selection initialised past the last entry, label callback deck_swap_draw_search_history_item. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, history window. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_open_text_search).

Allocates (or reuses) the progress window (record +0x54) and opens it with caption word 0xa6, no items and the drawer ui_draw_search_progress_bar. Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, progress window. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_run_text_search).

Opens the two windows that show the active filter inside the search dialog (record +0x58 and +0x5c) below the main window, with the drawers ui_draw_search_filter_label and deck_swap_draw_search_scope_label. Returns 1 when opened (0 on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, filter windows. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_open_text_search).

Calls ui_update_list_window for each existing filter window (record 0x00019ff8 +0x58, +0x5c; the window pointer is passed in a0, which Ghidra hides). Returns nothing. Side effects: window animation state. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Draws each existing filter window (record +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_draw_list_window(list_ptr, window), advancing *list_ptr. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_text_search_menu).
Calls ui_list_window_start_close for each existing filter window (record +0x58, +0x5c). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Calls ui_list_window_reset for each existing filter window (record +0x58, +0x5c). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 2 (ui_close_text_search_menu, deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).
Frees each existing filter window from heap 0x00018fb8 (the pointers at +0x58/+0x5c are left as they are). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_close_text_search_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_search_filter_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the first search filter window: draws dictionary word 0x84 (resource 0x8033) in white at scale 0xc fitted to width at (x, y) (ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit_2) inside a font external list. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window drawer set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit_2(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) as a tail call (Ghidra shows an empty body). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_search_filter_label, deck_swap_draw_search_scope_label).

column2: void deck_swap_draw_search_scope_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the second search filter window: draws dictionary word 0x83 (scope 0x00018fa6 = 0, search inside the filter) or 0x82 (scope 1) in black at scale 0xc, fitted to width at (x, y - 2). Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window drawer set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

When the active list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9 non-zero) and Triangle was pressed (pad +4 bit 0x1000), toggles the search scope 0x00018fa6 between 0 (search the filtered view) and 1 (clear the filter and search the whole list). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x00018fa6. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Draws the text-search dialog: in layout modes 2 and above first redraws the inactive pane (0x0000fb34), then the main window (+0x4c) and the progress window (+0x54) when present, and the filter windows (ui_draw_search_filter_windows). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays).

Drawer (+0x100) of the text-search main window: draws the history window when present, the input box from resource 0x8006 (caps and a 0xb5-wide body at y + 4 + extra height, blinking with the frame timer while the box is not focused), the cursor frame when the box is focused in state 0, the query text (ui_window_draw_text_px, scale 0xc, white) and the OK button (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when focused) with dictionary word 0x20 centred. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback set by deck_swap_open_text_search).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text_2(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_search_input_box).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text); text is passed through in its register (hidden by the decompiler). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (deck_swap_draw_search_input_box, deck_swap_draw_search_history_item).

column2: void deck_swap_draw_search_history_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the search history window: draws history string 0x00018d3c + item x 0x40 at (x, y centred in the item height +0xf2) in black at scale 0xc, clipped to the item width +0xf0. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_swap_open_search_history_window).

Drawer of the progress window: draws the bar frame from resource 0x8006 (v 0xf8, 7 px high: caps at x and x + 0xa0, body 0x9c wide at x + 4, all at y + 8) and the fill of width progress (+0x46, 0-1000) x 0x9a / 1000 with its end caps, the body only when the width is positive. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_progress_window).

Completion callback of the on-screen keyboard: when the search record exists, is in state 0 and the query (+6) is not empty, moves the focus (+4 bits 0-1) to the OK button (2). Returns nothing. Side effects: search record. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_start_osk_input by deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Sub-module draw. In states 0 and 10 only clears layer 0 to black. While the card viewer runs (0x0001901c bit 0) draws it (ui_card_viewer_draw). Otherwise clears layer 0, selects layer 4 with texturing and alpha blending and, when the OSK backdrop is active (0x00018fe0 bit 6 and 0x0001901c bit 5), draws the captured backdrop (0x00013574); else draws the background (deck_swap_draw_background), the card text panel (0x0000f438 with 0x00018ff0), the panes (0x0000e678), the overlays (deck_swap_draw_overlays) and the fade. With bit 6 set it then either updates the OSK (ui_update_osk_input(4); clears bit 6 when it finishes) or, on the first frame, captures the screen (ui_capture_screen_backdrop) and sets 0x0001901c bit 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE layers, OSK state, flags. Callers: exported (1 further import stub without callers; hypothesis, medium: called by the parent module through the library entry).

Draws the cursor and overlays: in states 1, 7 and 8 the blinking cursor frame (shop_draw_cursor_frame with resource 0x8006 at the rectangle 0x00018f9c-0x00018fa3); in states 7 and 8 (L or R held) the button help (shop_draw_button_help with resources 0x8013 and 0x8033, mode 0 or 1, placed away from the cursor by layout) and for 7 the sort group header (0x0000fc6c); state 2 the moving card (deck_swap_draw_card_move), 3 the command menu, 4 the sort menu, 5 the filter menu, 6 the text search; and the message window when one is open. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw).

Draws the static parts of the screen in order: background EHF (deck_swap_draw_background_ehf), tab EHF (deck_swap_draw_tabs_ehf), list row stripes for the current layout, 0x0000e480, pane status (deck_swap_draw_pane_status), 0x0000df8c, 0x0000e084 and, with a network session active, 0x0000e224. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw).

When resource 0x8021 is loaded, plays it with ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_draw (0x60-byte parameter block whose first word is the frame timing) / ui_ehf_end_draw, then re-enables texturing (state 4), sets the texture function and the alpha blend. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_background).

When resource 0x8022 is loaded, plays it with ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_draw (frame timing in the parameter block) / ui_ehf_end_draw; its play range is set by deck_swap_play_tab_frame. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_background).

Draws the faint row separators of list-layout panes as untextured line pairs from 0x240 bytes of inline data, positions chosen by layout (ui_fill_row_stripe_vertices per row). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_background).

column2: void ui_fill_row_stripe_vertices(void *vertices, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Writes four 12-byte vertices (u32 colour, s16 x, y, z = 0) for two horizontal lines from x to x + width: at y in colour 0x33000000 and at y + 1 in 0x19000000. Returns nothing. Side effects: vertices. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_list_row_stripes).

Draws the status line of pane 0 (and pane 1 in two-pane layouts): sort key icon (ui_draw_table_icon_a_2), sort order icon (shop_draw_sort_order_icon), and when filtered the filter icon (ui_draw_table_icon_a; blinking while the filter message 4 is shown for that pane) with the filtered count (shop_draw_small_digits, resource 0x8009) right-aligned by digit count; then the pane's scrollbar (shop_draw_scrollbar) in rows of the column count or in entries for list layout, and finally the list tabs (deck_swap_draw_list_tabs). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_background).

Draws the tabs of lists 0-2 (main, extra, side): for each, the label rectangle (deck_swap_calc_list_tab_rect) gets the total copies (list +0xc) drawn with ui_draw_list_tab_count (digit count from the byte table 0x00018bb0) and the tab label (ui_draw_list_tab_label in the count rectangle from deck_swap_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow); in single-pane layouts all three tabs belong to pane 0, otherwise tabs 0-1 to pane 0 and tab 2 to pane 1. column2: int ui_start_osk_input(ushort *buffer, ushort *title, int max_chars, void *callback)
column3: Starts Sony's on-screen keyboard: clears the keyboard block at 0x00019ffc, inhibits soft reset, remembers buffer (0x0001a1a8) and callback (0x0001a1ac), copies at most 24 units of buffer as the initial text collapsing each '$$' pair to '$', and fills the sceUtilityOsk parameter block at 0x0001a000 (OSK language by game language, button swap from system_get_confirm_button, description = title, output length = max_chars). On a successful sceUtilityOskInitStart it starts a fade-out and sets the state byte to 1; system_net_set_word_bafc(0) is called first. Returns the sceUtilityOskInitStart result (0 on success). Side effects: keyboard block, soft-reset inhibit, fade. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_update_text_search_menu).

Per-frame keyboard step by the state byte 0x00019ffc: in states 1-3 draws the fade on GE layer layer; in states 1-2 polls sceUtilityOskGetStatus and, when the dialog finished, shuts it down, copies the result back into the caller's buffer doubling every '$' when the dialog result is 0, calls the callback, fades in and moves to 3. State 4 restores system_net_set_word_bafc(1) and soft reset. Returns 1 when the keyboard is finished, else 0. Side effects: keyboard block, caller's buffer, fades, callback. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw).

Binary search of value in the ascending u16 list table[1..table[0]]; returns its index, or 0 when table is NULL or value is absent (indistinguishable from index 0). No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_swap_build_extra_list, deck_swap_build_side_list, deck_swap_build_main_list).

Counts the entries of a sorted u32 table {u32 count, u32 entries[count]} whose low 16 bits equal card_id, stopping at the first larger id (the high half is the artwork number). Returns the count. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_by_genre).

Callers: 5 (deck_swap_draw_count_differences, shop_draw_results_row_badges, deck_swap_draw_time_limit, ui_draw_sort_group_header, ...).

Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_race_icon).

column3: When icon (card_db_get_icon of a spell or trap) is non-zero draws its cell with shop_draw_sprite_rect: u = (icon - 1) x 0x11, v = 0x33. Returns the advanced list (unchanged for icon 0). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_spell_trap_icon).

column2: uint *shop_draw_button_help(void *list, int x, int y, int variant, uint buttons, void *image, void *dict)
column3: Draws a button help panel at (x, y): a 0xd4-wide panel with a 0x2f x 0x26 button diagram from image; the dictionary word numbers come from one of two u16 tables of this module by variant and the words from dict: bit 0 a caption with an icon, 0x1000 (Triangle) a title, 0x4000 (Cross) a bottom line, 0x8000 (Square) and 0x2000 (Circle) texts in the left and right boxes; in variant 1 the Cross and Circle words are swapped when the confirm button is not Cross; then a header tab above the panel. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_swap_draw_overlays, with variant 0 for hold-L and 1 for hold-R, buttons 0xf001, resources 0x8013 and 0x8033).
